evidence: Contribution-margin-after-ads formula per _shared/unit-economics.md (REF-ECON-001) §3: Profit-per-SKU = Gia ban - base print - shipping - (ShopBase+payment fee ~2.9%+$0.30) - ad cost(CPA) - VAT(EU) - fx; Contribution Margin = Profit-per-SKU / Gia ban. Explicitly NOT the gross formula gia=cost/(1-margin) (§3: a 'gross 50%' SKU can be contribution-negative after CPA $20 + VAT).

BE-ROAS definition per unit-economics.md §2 and pricing-decision.schema.json field break_even_roas: BE-ROAS = 1 / gross_margin_pre_ads, gross_margin_pre_ads = (net_price - base - ship - fee)/net_price. Canonical US $49.99 worked example GM 36.4% -> BE-ROAS 2.75 (doc §4).
